title: Indicator sum as a predicate count
statement: Let $q$ be a nonnegative integer and let $P$ be a predicate on $\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$. The sum, over these indices, of $1$ when $P(i)$ holds and $0$ otherwise equals the number of entries satisfying $P$ in the ordered list $0,1,\\ldots,q-1$.�
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on the indices $0,\\ldots,q-1$
